# Alides Qatar

> Alides is a retained, partner-led executive search and board advisory firm based in Doha, serving boards, family-owned groups, government-related entities, institutions and investors in Qatar. Member of ECI Group (international executive search network) and of the AESC (Association of Executive Search and Leadership Consultants). Part of Alides, with offices in Casablanca, Paris and Doha.

Contact: contact@eci-alides.com · +974 5579 0920 · https://qa.alides.org/#contact

## Advisory services
- [Board Advisory & Independent Director Search in Qatar | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/board-advisory-qatar/): Board advisory and independent director search in Qatar. Alides advises chairmen and boards on composition, independence and lead director nominations, with awareness of the QFMA governance expectations. Member of ECI Group. Member of the AESC.
- [CEO Succession Planning in Qatar | Leadership Continuity | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/ceo-succession-qatar/): CEO succession planning and leadership continuity in Qatar. Alides advises boards and principals on chief executive transitions, planned and sensitive, from brief to appointment and beyond. Member of ECI Group. Member of the AESC.
- [Energy & Industrial Executive Search in Qatar | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/energy-industry-qatar/): Retained executive search and board advisory for Qatar's energy, LNG, petrochemical and industrial organisations. CEO, COO, CFO, HSE and project leadership, conducted from Doha. Member of ECI Group and the AESC.
- [Executive Search in Doha, Qatar | Retained C-Suite Search | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/executive-search-doha/): Retained, partner-led executive search in Doha for Qatar's boards, family-owned groups and institutions. CEO, CFO, CIO, CHRO and COO appointments conducted in confidence. Member of ECI Group. Member of the AESC.
- [Family Business & Family Office Advisory in Qatar | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/family-business-family-office-qatar/): Family business and family office advisory in Qatar. Alides advises family principals on governance, professionalisation, executive committees and key appointments across finance, risk and investment. Member of ECI Group. Member of the AESC.
- [Financial Services Executive Search in Qatar | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/financial-services-qatar/): Retained executive search and board advisory for Qatar's banks, investment firms, insurers, Islamic finance and QFC-licensed institutions. CEO, CFO, CRO, compliance and board appointments, from Doha.
- [Leadership Advisory & Executive Assessment in Qatar | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/leadership-advisory-qatar/): Leadership advisory and executive assessment in Qatar. Alides advises boards and principals on independent assessment, executive committee design and leadership architecture. Member of ECI Group. Member of the AESC.
- [Public Sector & Sovereign Capital Executive Search in Qatar | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/public-sector-sovereign-qatar/): Retained executive search and board advisory in Qatar for government-related entities, sovereign and public investment platforms, and national institutions. CEO, CIO and board appointments, conducted in confidence from Doha.
- [Qatarisation & Leadership Pipeline Advisory | Alides Qatar](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/qatarisation-leadership/): Qatarisation and leadership pipeline advisory in Qatar. Alides helps boards and institutions build credible Qatari leadership for boards and executive teams, aligned with National Vision 2030. Member of ECI Group. Member of the AESC.

## Insights
- [Appointing a CEO Today: What Boards Really Expect | Alides Qatar](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/insights/appointing-a-ceo-today/): What boards in Qatar truly expect of a chief executive today — strategic legibility, the capacity to align the top team, and command of the political. A perspective from Alides.
- [Insights on Leadership, Succession & Governance in Qatar | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/insights/): Perspectives from Alides on leadership, CEO succession, board governance and transformation in Qatar — written for chairmen, boards, family principals and institutional investors.
- [Institutionalising the Family Office: From Trusted Aide to Institution | Alides Qatar](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/insights/institutionalising-the-family-office/): How entrepreneurial families turn an informal patrimonial organisation into a family office that outlives its founder: the audit, the three separations, the first hire and the next generation. An Alides strategic brief.
- [Leadership Is a System, Not a Competence | Alides Qatar](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/insights/leadership-is-a-system/): Why leadership at the top is better understood as a system to be aligned than a competence to be developed. A perspective on governance and power from Alides Qatar.
- [Reorganising with Intent: Five Decisions Before You Restructure | Alides Qatar](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/insights/reorganising-with-intent/): Five structuring decisions leaders should weigh before reorganising — strategic clarity, the executive committee, succession, talent-to-value, and quiet transformation. A perspective from Alides Qatar.
- [The False Move of False Change: Why 70% of Transformations Fail | Alides Qatar](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/insights/the-false-move-of-false-change/): Why close to 70% of transformations fall short — and what distinguishes real change from its appearance. A perspective on leadership and execution from Alides Qatar.
- [The Silent CEO Crisis: Tenure, Pressure and the Board's Blind Spot | Alides Qatar](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/insights/the-silent-ceo-crisis/): Record turnover, shortening tenures and invisible burnout are reshaping executive leadership. Why it matters for boards and family offices in Qatar. A perspective from Alides.
- [The True Cost of an Appointment: Leadership Value Beyond the Hire | Alides Qatar](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/insights/the-true-cost-of-an-appointment/): Why a leader's value is decided long after they take office: the full economics of an appointment, why performance never travels alone, internal versus external, and the board's duty after signature. An Alides strategic brief.
- [Why CEO Successions Fail — and How Boards Avoid It | Alides Qatar](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/insights/why-ceo-successions-fail/): Why chief executive successions fail, and what boards in Qatar can do to avoid it. The three recurring errors, and what successful transitions share. A perspective from Alides.

## About
- [Executive Search Qatar | Board & Leadership Advisory in Doha | Alides](https://qa.alides.org/): Alides Qatar advises boards, family-owned groups, institutions and strategic investors in Doha on executive search, CEO succession, board appointments, governance and leadership advisory. Member of ECI Group. Member of the AESC.
- [The Partner | Mehdi El Idrissi, Managing Partner | Alides Qatar](https://qa.alides.org/qatar/about/): Alides in Qatar is led personally by Mehdi El Idrissi, Managing Partner — a former CFO, CEO and director-general decorated as Chevalier de l'Ordre du Mérite, advising boards, families and institutions. Member of ECI Group. Member of the AESC.
